capabilities: Render a live progress bar above a checklist block
Count checked and open items, including nested ones
Set the bar colour with a two-letter code
Switch the counter between fraction and open/done styles
extras: The counter style setting applies to every progress bar in the vault; the open note updates immediately, other notes on their next edit.
problem: Obsidian checklists give no at-a-glance measure of how much of a list is done, especially for long or nested lists.
summary: Callout-driven progress bar that counts checked items in the checklist block below it and updates live.
